headline: Inclusionary zoning ordinance changes and a new incentives section, plus a tabled use regulations amendment.
summary: The committee will take up a tabled amendment to the city's use regulations. It will also consider two inclusionary zoning items, one replacing the full ordinance and one adding an incentives section.
items: Tabled paper 327A-26: amend Code of the City of Malden 12.12.030 use regulations
335-26: replace the inclusionary zoning ordinance, MCC 12.12.300, in its entirety
335A-26: add new sub-section F. Incentives to inclusionary zoning, MCC 12.12.300
location: Room 105, Malden City Hall, 215 Pleasant Street, Malden, MA 02148
